Volkswagen removed from Euro Stoxx 50 index

Volkswagen has been removed from the Euro Stoxx 50 index, a blue-chip stock market index for large companies in the Eurozone. This follows a recent profit warning issued by the car manufacturer. The move signifies further pressure on the company.
